title: The degree-diameter problem for bipartite graphs

template.title: Bipartite graph of maximum degree {d} and diameter {k}
template.statement: Find a bipartite graph of maximum degree at most {d} and diameter at most {k}, with as many vertices as possible.
template.submission: Text file: one graph in graph6 or sparse6, or an edge list (one edge "u v" per line, vertices numbered from 0).

best_text: The largest known bipartite graph in the Combinatorics Wiki's table has {best} vertices ({holder}); a graph with more vertices improves it.
open_rule: every entry of the table (degree 3 to 16, diameter 3 to 10) not in bold (bold entries are optimal), with at most 20,000 vertices
keeper: Combinatorics Wiki (E. Loz, H. Pérez-Rosés, G. Pineda-Villavicencio and contributors), The Degree Diameter Problem for Bipartite Graphs
revision: pages read 15 Nov 2026 12:13 UTC (SHA-256 in page_sha256)
score: the number of vertices (larger is better)
holder_unknown: not named in the table's colour key
holder_sources: the colour of the entry in the table and the page's colour key
